[P2] Release invoke holds when their enclosing context completes

A non-durable invoke from an early-completed parallel remains tracked until the entire execution unregisters. Race a one-second wait against a function that never resolves using `minSuccessful: 1`, then await a one-hour wait in the same handler. The parallel completes, but this guard still blocks clock advancement: `invoke.end()` never runs, and the caller cannot unregister until its subsequent wait finishes. That wait therefore takes a real hour despite `skipTime`. Track the invoke's enclosing context and release its hold when that context completes. Extend the regression to perform another wait within the same execution.
